text:
mika: Quick async check-in from overnight shift — short format (did / blockers / today)

mika: Did: drained 2 flaky GPU nodes in us-west1, verified that running containers rescheduled to us-central. Confirmed no user-facing errors in the recent spike.

mika: Blocker: hit a hard quota on GPUs in us-central (request 2 more g4dn) when trying to rebalance; autoscaler didn't kick the extra nodepool.

mika: Today: opening a quota ticket + follow up with cloud team, and re-run canary for the scheduler fix.

aj: Thanks — saw the drain logs, nice sleuthing. Can you paste the drain command you used?

mika: Sure — ran:
```
kubectl drain gce-node-27 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Then cordoned the node and watched pod eviction.

aj: Nice. For autoscaler not spinning up, did you see any errors in cluster-autoscaler logs?

mika: I checked briefly — it logged "no capacity constraints matched" and a HTTP 403 when trying a quota probe to the cloud API. Suspect permission / quota-limit response.

quota-bot: Notice: GPU quota for project-redwood-prod in us-central1 at 98% utilization. Recommend filing quota increase if you expect growth.

sahil: Re: quota — I can jump on the cloud ticket once you file. Heads-up: internal approval for more g4dn can take ~6-8 hours.

esther: Ping @aj and @kim — this could affect the evening burst tests. If we can't get quota quick, can we redirect the canary traffic to eu-west1 temporarily?

aj: We can, but need to confirm model replicas and prefix cache availability in eu-west1. Redirecting will increase latency for some customers.

kim: I'm fine with temporary redirect if we put a note on status page and restrict to internal canary traffic only. I'll draft a short incident note. :memo:

mika: Can we do a short re-route for canary only? I can change routing policy to prefer eu-west1 for canary label — quick config change:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  - match: {label: "canary"}
    prefer_regions: ["eu-west1", "us-west1"]
```
I'll push after we confirm with @aj.

aj: Go ahead and push the config for canary reroute. Please put a rollback command in the PR and ping me.

mika: Will do — opening PR now. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-config/pull/912

mika: Also filing cloud ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-842 (quota bump request + autoscaler debug logs attached).

sahil: Thanks — I'll add the allocation justification and costs. If approval is delayed, I'll schedule a short slot to shift some non-critical workloads to spot in ap-south1 to free up headroom.

esther: FYI ops playbook note: when shifting region for canary, update the Console route override and mark the rollout as "constrained-az" in approval notes.

kim: Drafted status blurb and posted to #status-digest. LMK if you want me to escalate to support.

mika: Quick ask: @aj can you review PR 912 after I add rollback? Trying to get this low-friction.

aj: On it, will review in ~30m.

quota-bot: Update: quota ticket INFRA-842 status changed to "awaiting-approval".

mika: Thanks all — will update thread after PR merge and quota approval. :thumbsup:
